test_tap2pcap_integration: test the tap2pcap module by converting a tapped trace to pcap and validating output with tshark
run_tap2pcap_conversion: run tap2pcap to convert a protobuf text tap file into a pcap file for analysis
validate_tap2pcap_output: validate tap2pcap output by comparing tshark dump against a golden expected text file
